key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) turns policy mirror descent into a trajectory-level objective for terminal-reward generation, removing the need to estimate intermediate state values.
engineering_relevance: This provides a simpler critic-free reinforcement learning recipe for training reasoning LLMs with verifiable rewards, which can reduce implementation complexity and instability.
method: Uses Bellman equations to rewrite PMD for autoregressive sequences with terminal rewards.
Derives a practical loss by approximating the trajectory objective.
Applies a smoothed complementary-probability ratio as a mismatch-correction weight.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks showing that BPO is effective.
watch_item: The approximation and mismatch-correction weighting may be sensitive to reward sparsity and sequence-length effects in real training setups.
